newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia 1996 cane crush a record 39.5 mln/t.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia 1996 cane crush a record 39.5 mln/t.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush for 1996 rose to a record 39.543 million tonnes from 37.389 million in 1995, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
Sugar content for the latest year was 13.50 percent against 13.12 percent the year before, it said.

The crush ended on January 4, with 47,438 tonnes of cane crushed in the latest week of the season, all in New South Wales. Crushing in the main sugar-producing state of Queensland finished weeks before. Queensland's total sugar crush for the latest year amounted to 37.161 million tonnes, up from 35.295 million tonnes the year before, CANEGROWERS said.
The 1996 crush in New South Wales amounted to 2.382 million tonnes, up from 2.095 million tonnes the year before. Australia produced 4.978 million tonnes of raw sugar in 1995.
Australian sugar cane crush for the 1996 season, ended January 4, 1997 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ended by December 30.
CCS = Commercial Cane Sugar (sugar content percent)-
